channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: New platform Legacy Lawns launches with 5 unified brands
item.description: King Green, Purple Care, Georgia Lawngrowers, Coastal Turf and Perm-O-Green are now under the Legacy Lawns umbrella.

item.title: Envu rolls out Horizon Rewards program
item.description: LCOs who enroll in Envu Horizon Rewards before April 1 can receive points on eligible purchases made between January 1 and June 30, with rewards deposited in September.

item.title: Marshall Dirks to retire from Proven Winners North America
item.description: Brian Oster, currently the senior marketing director for Proven Winners North America, will assume Dirks' responsibilities.

item.title: Agri-Fab debuts 60-gallon sprayer
item.description: The unit also offers a quick disconnect for convenient electrical hookup with its two-wire fused wiring harness.

item.title: Ruppert Landscape promotes Corrales to Fairfax branch manager
item.description: Cynthia Corrales has been with Ruppert Landscape for more than a decade, joining the organization in 2014 as a receptionist in Gainesville, Virginia.

item.title: The Service Edge Conference returns in Nashville this February
item.description: SEC26, which runs Feb. 17-18, will feature keynote presentations from TShane Johnson and Steve Baker.

item.title: Munro names Atherton as Great Lakes regional account manager
item.description: Atherton will work closely with the company’s network of professional distributors for support.

item.title: The Aquatrols Company redesigns website
item.description: The new platform brings together the recently merged legacy brands of Aquatrols and Precision Laboratories under The Aquatrols Company identity.

item.title: Georgia Boot introduces Wedge Superlyte collection
item.description: The Wedge Superlyte collection features three new full grain leather styles.

item.title: Truce Software showcases features at WorkWave's conference in Dallas
item.description: Truce combines mobile device control, vehicle telematics and AI-powered dashcams to prevent distracted driving.
